WITH france_sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.country_id,
        c.country_name,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND c.country_id = 52779
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
france_sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.country_id,
        c.country_name,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND c.country_id = 52779
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        f2019.calendar_month_number,
        f2019.total_sales as sales_2019,
        f2020.total_sales as sales_2020,
        ((f2020.total_sales - f2019.total_sales) * 1.0 / f2019.total_sales) as growth_rate
    FROM france_sales_2019 f2019
    JOIN france_sales_2020 f2020 ON f2019.calendar_month_number = f2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        mg.calendar_month_number,
        ((mg.sales_2020 - mg.sales_2019) * 1.0 / mg.sales_2019) * mg.sales_2020 + mg.sales_2020 as projected_sales
    FROM monthly_growth mg
),
usd_converted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0) as projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY projected_sales_usd) as median_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM usd_converted
